aboutGame.title: What is First Person Boxing?
paragraphs: First Person Boxing is a first-person boxing experience on Roblox developed by Can You Box?. Instead of watching a fighter from the outside, you look through your own eyes, read your opponent's tells, and land every punch yourself across PvP matches and AI practice sessions.

Exchanges are built on stance, guard discipline, and stamina management rather than button combos. Slip timing, distance control, and counter windows decide who wins a round, and our First Person Boxing wiki breaks each system down with keybind tables, step-by-step drills, and matchup guides.

modules.name: First Person Boxing Beginner Guide
modules.description: New to the ring? This First Person Boxing beginner guide covers setup, stance, footwork, and punch tracking with a clear path from your first match to landing clean counters.

highlights.detail: Set up a clear play space and calibrate your headset or controller before the first bell
Build a balanced stance with your lead foot forward and hands at cheekbone height
Snap straight punches out and back to guard so the tracker reads clean lines
Treat defense first: block, slip, and reset instead of trading wild swings
Take your fundamentals into a first match and review what broke down

modules.name: First Person Boxing Controls
modules.description: Every input that matters in First Person Boxing: movement, jabs, crosses, blocking, and slipping across keyboard, gamepad, and VR, with exact bindings and rebinding tips.

highlights.label: W A S D
highlights.detail: Move and circle — keeps footwork on one hand with standard FPS muscle memory

highlights.label: Mouse 1
highlights.detail: Jab (lead hand) — the fastest input for finding range and testing a guard

highlights.label: Mouse 2
highlights.detail: Cross (rear hand) — pairs with the jab so both punches share one hand

highlights.label: Space
highlights.detail: Block / guard (hold) — thumb or pinky, never a punch finger

highlights.label: Shift + Punch
highlights.detail: Uppercut modifier — prevents accidental mis-inputs mid-exchange

highlights.label: Double-tap A / D
highlights.detail: Slip left or right — keeps your hands free to fire the counter

modules.name: First Person Boxing Slip and Counter Guide
modules.description: How slipping and blocking turn a missed punch into free damage. Follow the five-step cycle for defensive timing, counter windows, and resetting to range.

highlights.detail: Confirm the opponent is closing in for a punch, not feinting to draw a reaction
Identify the attack line and move off it, not with it
Slip at the last safe moment so the punch misses but you stay in range
Counter immediately while the opponent is still recovering from the miss
Reset to movement and guard so you are not stationary for the follow-up

modules.name: First Person Boxing Knockout Guide
modules.description: Create knockout chances in First Person Boxing through accurate punching, defensive reactions, and stamina management instead of wild swinging.

highlights.label: Range
highlights.detail: Own the long, mid, short, and break zones to land two shots and exit at an angle

highlights.label: Timing
highlights.detail: Fire counters inside the commitment window, not while the punch is still loading

highlights.label: Stamina
highlights.detail: Punch in bunches and keep enough gas so your guard does not drop late

highlights.label: Guard
highlights.detail: Keep hands high so an opponent's missed punch becomes your knockout opening

faq.title: First Person Boxing FAQ
faq.description: Quick answers to the most common questions about First Person Boxing.

items.question: What is First Person Boxing?
items.answer: First Person Boxing is a first-person boxing experience on Roblox from developer Can You Box?. You fight through your own eyes, reading opponent tells and throwing real punches in PvP matches and AI practice sessions.

items.question: How do I start playing First Person Boxing?
items.answer: Clear a safe play space, learn the control map, and drill your stance and guard before your first match. Our beginner guide walks through setup, footwork, and punch tracking step by step.

items.question: What are the First Person Boxing controls?
items.answer: Movement sits on WASD, the lead-hand jab on the left mouse button, the rear-hand cross on the right, and block or guard on the space bar. Slips map to double-taps or dedicated keys, and every input can be rebound.

items.question: Are there First Person Boxing codes?
items.answer: Codes arrive around updates and milestones. When they go live, paste them exactly as written in the Codes menu and confirm before closing the game. Our codes page tracks what is active right now.

items.question: How do I get better at First Person Boxing?
items.answer: Defense creates offense. Drill the slip-and-counter cycle, manage stamina across rounds, and study matchup guides for the opponent styles you keep losing to.
